name: repocrew
description: RepoCrew — hosted-preview launcher shim. The app itself lives in backend/ (FastAPI) and frontend/ (Vite); locally use run.ps1 or run.sh instead.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: sh -c '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] && PY=.venv/bin/python || PY=python3; exec "$PY" -m uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port "${PORT:-3000}"'
